column3: the expression “UK retail investor” means a person who is one (or more) of the following: (A) a retail client, as defined in point (8) of Article 2 of Commission  Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/565 as it forms part of the domestic law of the UK and as amended; or (B) a customer within the meaning of the provisions of the FSMA and any rules or regulations made under the FSMA to implement Directive  (EU) 2016/97 (such rules or regulations, as amended), where that customer would not qualify as a professional client, as defined in point (8) of Article 2(1) of Regulation (EU) No 600/2014 as it forms part of the domestic law of the UK and  as amended; or (C) not a qualified investor as defined in Article 2 of the UK Prospectus Regulation; and
